observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a single light-colored, clean wooden pallet with no visible wear, cracks, or staining, standing alone on a warehouse floor.
Photo 2 shows a stacked pile of visibly old, dark, weathered wooden pallets with worn edges, some broken slats, and exposed nails.
The condition shown in photo 2 is markedly different from photos 0 and 1, suggesting the images may not all represent the same stock.
No brand, manufacturer mark, ISPM-15 heat-treatment stamp, or model number is legible in any photo.
No ruler, tape measure, or size reference is present in any photo to confirm standard pallet dimensions.
Seller's text is generic marketing copy about pallets in general and does not state specific condition, quantity, size, or treatment of the item for sale.

claims.claim: Wooden pallets are the backbone of supply chain logistics, manufacturing, and warehousing...
claims.evidence: Generic marketing statement, not a specific claim about the item's condition, size, or quantity; nothing in the photos confirms or denies it.

risks.risk: Mismatch between the clean new-looking pallet in photos 0/1 and the worn, stacked used pallets in photo 2 — unclear which condition is actually being sold.
risks.proof: A single clear photo or short video of the exact pallet(s) to be delivered, taken together in one frame.
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lower-grade used/worn pallet condition shown in photo 2

risks.risk: Actual pallet dimensions (e.g. standard 1200x1000mm Euro/CHEP size vs non-standard) cannot be confirmed.
risks.proof: Photo with a tape measure or ruler against the pallet's length and width.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic non-standard size, not assumed to match premium standard sizing

risks.risk: No ISPM-15 heat-treatment or fumigation stamp is visible, which matters for export/commercial use pricing.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the stamped block on the pallet block/stringer.

risks.risk: Quantity being sold is unclear — single unit vs bulk stack.
risks.proof: Seller's text or photo stating exact count of pallets included in this listing.

risks.risk: Structural soundness (cracks, loose boards, missing blocks) cannot be fully assessed from distant or staged shots.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all four corners and the underside/stringers.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having visible wear and potential weak points, per photo 2

proof_requests: A single photo/video showing the exact pallet(s) included in this sale, side by side if multiple.
A photo with a measuring tape against the pallet to confirm dimensions.
A close-up of any stamp or marking on the block/stringer (for treatment/brand identification).
Confirmation of exact quantity included in the listed price.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a wooden pallet by type, but the photos show conflicting conditions (new vs heavily used), so it must be priced at the worse condition shown until a consistent, verified photo is provided.
